Home > Products > Hand-carried RF Detection System

Hand-carried RF Detection System

Detection Radius: 5km
Operating Frequency: 300MHz-6000MHz
Passive detection with zero electromagnetic emission; multi-mode recognition (spectrum analysis & protocol decoding); high mobility for individual soldier deployment and rapid response.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The hand-carried RF detection system offers full-band detection across 300MHz to 6000MHz. It enables the detection, identification, positioning, tracking, and audio-visual alarming of drones within its range. Upon activation, the device automatically enters operation. It is characterized by high portability, mobility, and rapid deployment capabilities.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Key Features

  • Portable design, lightweight and easy to carry, suitable for rapid deployment.
  • Broadband real-time spectrum sensing, capable of full-band drone signal detection and identification.
  • Maximum detection range up to 3km, automatically detects drone intrusions in the surveillance area.
  • Recognizes drone type/model, flight control signals, image transmission signals, etc.
  • Built-in high-capacity battery supporting continuous operation for over 4 hours.
  • Integrated display screen for real-time monitoring of detection status.
  • Standard interfaces for integration with other counter-UAS equipment.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Frequency Range300MHz-6000MHz
Detection ModePassive detection, Spectrum analysis, Protocol decoding
Detection Angle360° Horizontal
Detection Radius5km
Direction Accuracy≤3° (RMS)
Identification Time≤3s
Screen Size13.3 inch
Power SupplyBattery/Adapter
IP RatingIP65
Max Power80W
Battery Endurance5h
Weight16kg
Operating Temp-20℃ to +55℃
